name: @remotex/protocol
description: Shared wire protocol for RemoteX: web client <-> Electron agent. Fast binary channel (move/scroll/cursor/ping) + reliable JSON ctl channel.

scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.esm.json && tsc -p tsconfig.cjs.json && node -e "require('fs').writeFileSync('dist/esm/package.json', JSON.stringify({type:'module'})); require('fs').writeFileSync('dist/cjs/package.json', JSON.stringify({type:'commonjs'}))"
scripts.test: npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test dist-test/test/protocol.test.js
